idea-plugin.name: TypingLua Language Server
idea-plugin.description:
Starts the TypingLua language server (a LuaLS fork) for .lua files, providing inline type annotation support (e.g. local x: number = 42).

This plugin is LSP-only — it does not provide syntax highlighting. Use your preferred Lua plugin (e.g. EmmyLua) for highlighting.
